name: Mercury Dragon, Young
body:
YOUNG MERCURY DRAGON
CR 6

XP 2,400
CG Medium dragon (fire)
Init +1; Senses dragon senses, Perception +11

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 11, flat-footed 18 (+1 Dex, +8 natural)
hp 73 (7d12+28)
Fort +8, Ref +8, Will +6; +3 racial vs. light or pattern effects
Immune blindness, dazzle, fire, paralysis, sleep
Weaknesses vulnerability to cold

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft., fly 150 ft. (average)
Melee bite +11 (1d8+6), 2 claws +11 (1d6+4), 2 wings +9 (1d4+2)
Special Attacks breath weapon (60-ft. line, 6d6 fire), brilliance (90 ft. beam or 180 ft. cone, DC 14)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 7th, concentration +8)

At will—gaze screen (DC 13)

Spells Known (CL 1st, concentration +2)

1st (4/day)—alarm, color spray (DC 12)
0th (at will)—dancing lights, detect magic, flare (DC 11), light

STATISTICS

Str 19, Dex 12, Con 17, Int 12, Wis 13, Cha 12
Base Atk +7; CMB +11; CMD 22 (26 vs. trip)
Feats Acrobatic, Hover, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack
Skills Acrobatics +10/+13, Climb +14, Fly +13, Knowledge (nature) +11, Perception +11, Sense Motive +11, Spellcraft +11; Racial Modifiers +3 on Acrobatics skill checks to jump
Languages Draconic, Ignan

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Breath Weapon (Su)

A mercury dragon’s breath weapon is a line of intense light that burns whatever it touches, dealing fire damage.

Brilliance (Ex)

As a standard action, a mercury dragon can use the mirror-bright membranes of its wings to reflect and concentrate available light into a beam of dazzling brightness. To use this power, the dragon needs light as bright as an overcast day or clear, moonlight night. Torchlight or candle light is insufficient. The power creates a thin beam the dragon can aim at a single target within 30 feet per age category of the dragon. The target is blinded for 1d4+1 rounds unless it makes a Reflex save (DC 10 + ½ the dragon’s Hit Dice, + the dragon’s Dexterity modifier). If not using this technique as a weapon, the dragon can create a cone of light as bright as a daylight spell up to 60 feet long per age category of the dragon. The cone lasts 3 rounds.

Compression (Ex)

A mercury dragon can move through an area as small as one-quarter its space without squeezing or one-eighth its space when squeezing.

High Jump (Ex)

A very young or older mercury dragon receives a racial bonus equal to its age category on Acrobatics skill checks made to jump.

Protected Sight (Ex)

A young or older mercury dragon is immune to any effect that would blind or dazzle it. It also gains +3 racial bonus on saving throws against any light or pattern effects.

Spell-Like Abilities (Sp)

A mercury dragon gains the following spell-like abilities, usable at will upon reaching the listed age category.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate and warm mountains and underground
Organization solitary
Treasure triple

A mercury dragon is considered a true (metallic) dragon for the purpose of a sorcerer or bloodrager with the draconic bloodline, an oracle with the Dragon mystery, a shaman with the Dragon spirit, the Draconic Heritage and Draconic Manifestation feats, and similar effects. Its energy type is fire, and the granted breath weapon is a 60-foot line. A character using form of the dragon to transform into a mercury dragon gains the following abilities: 60-foot line of fire, resist fire 20, +4 bonus on saving throws against blinding, dazzling, or light and pattern effects, and vulnerability to cold.
